metrics.name: demand_screen_result
metrics.plain: Whether a candidate passed the first fast check
metrics.formula: pass/fail flag from the demand, competition and store-fit rule set applied to the candidate
metrics.window: at screening, refreshed if the candidate is rescreened
metrics.unavailable_when: candidate has not been screened yet
metrics.benchmark: no external benchmark; internal pass rate tracked over time

metrics.name: video_commerce_demand_signal
metrics.plain: How strong the social/video demand signal is, and from how many sources
metrics.formula: count of independent platforms and creators showing sustained views or sell-through above the category median, not a single clip
metrics.source: video-commerce and social-native platform pulls (TikTok-style shop data, native ad feeds)
metrics.unavailable_when: no pull run for this candidate
metrics.benchmark: 2 or more independent sources required before treating it as real (internal rule, no external benchmark)

metrics.name: ad_library_spend_signal
metrics.plain: How many advertisers keep spending on this product idea, and for how long
metrics.formula: count of distinct advertisers with an ad live for more than 90 days in public ad libraries for the candidate's category
metrics.unavailable_when: no ad library capture run for this candidate
metrics.benchmark: 3+ advertisers past 90 days is treated as a sustained-spend signal (internal rule)

metrics.name: research_time_used
metrics.plain: Hours spent researching this candidate against its budget
metrics.formula: sum of logged research hours for the candidate ÷ the time box set for its research stage
metrics.window: life of the candidate's research stage
metrics.freshness_rule: stale after 2 days without a log entry
metrics.unavailable_when: no time box has been set
metrics.benchmark: no external benchmark; time box is set per brand

metrics.name: trend_direction_score
metrics.plain: Whether the category is growing, flat or shrinking over several years
metrics.formula: slope of a multi-year search or sales trend index, normalised to a -1 to 1 score
metrics.unavailable_when: trend series not pulled for this category
metrics.benchmark: no external benchmark; read together with competitive_saturation_count

metrics.name: competitive_saturation_count
metrics.plain: How many sellers already compete in this category
metrics.formula: count of distinct active sellers or listings found for the category across the channels checked
metrics.unavailable_when: no scan run for this category
metrics.benchmark: no external benchmark; rising trend with low count is the target combination

metrics.name: demand_pattern_tag
metrics.plain: Evergreen, seasonal or trending label for the candidate
metrics.formula: rule-based tag from the trend series shape (flat, spiking, or one-off) plus review and search seasonality
metrics.unavailable_when: trend series too short to classify (under 12 months of data)
metrics.benchmark: not applicable, a label not a score

metrics.name: review_price_signal
metrics.plain: The price buyers say in reviews they would actually pay
metrics.formula: median of price mentions extracted from 1 to 5 star reviews on competing products in the category
metrics.unavailable_when: fewer than 20 price mentions found
metrics.benchmark: no external benchmark; compared against the candidate's planned price

metrics.name: review_complaint_rate
metrics.plain: How often the same unmet complaint shows up in competitor reviews
metrics.formula: count of reviews mentioning the top recurring complaint ÷ total reviews mined for that competitor product
metrics.unavailable_when: fewer than 20 reviews mined
metrics.benchmark: no external benchmark; a rate above 15% is treated internally as a real gap

metrics.name: contribution_margin_pct_modelled
metrics.plain: The margin the gate model expects after price, cost, shipping and duty
metrics.formula: (planned price − COGS − shipping − duty − payment fee) ÷ planned price
metrics.freshness_rule: stale after any input cost change of more than 3%
metrics.unavailable_when: gate has not been run for this candidate
metrics.benchmark: brand-set minimum contribution margin threshold (set once per brand, not hard-coded)

metrics.name: contribution_margin_pct_actual
metrics.plain: The margin a launched SKU is really making, from real sales
metrics.formula: (actual revenue − actual COGS − allocated shipping − allocated ad spend − returns cost) ÷ actual revenue, from sales and cost records
metrics.source: SKU sales and cost table (brand sales data joined to sourcing cost records)
metrics.freshness_rule: stale after 14 days without a sales refresh
metrics.unavailable_when: SKU has under 20 units sold in the window
metrics.benchmark: compared directly against contribution_margin_pct_modelled for the same SKU

metrics.name: compliance_gate_status
metrics.plain: Whether the candidate's regulatory checks are cleared
metrics.formula: pass/fail flag from the compliance checklist attached to the margin gate (labelling, category-specific certification)
metrics.unavailable_when: compliance checklist not yet run
metrics.benchmark: not applicable, a gate not a score

metrics.name: differentiation_angle_confidence
metrics.plain: How solid the stated point of difference is
metrics.formula: rule score from whether the angle field is filled, is backed by a named source (review gap, teardown or field research), and is not a copy of a competitor's own claim
metrics.unavailable_when: angle field is empty
metrics.benchmark: not applicable, an internal check not a market score

metrics.name: shortlist_score
metrics.plain: A candidate's rank on the fixed scorecard
metrics.formula: weighted sum of the scorecard's fixed criteria (demand, margin, differentiation, compliance, cash timing), weights set once per brand
metrics.unavailable_when: candidate has not reached the shortlist stage
metrics.benchmark: ranked against other candidates in the same batch, not an absolute score

metrics.name: go_live_gate_pass_count
metrics.plain: How many of the 5 go-live gates a candidate has cleared
metrics.formula: count of passed gates (provable claim, owned difference, brand threshold, contribution margin, ad-cost ceiling) ÷ 5
metrics.freshness_rule: stale after any linked cost or claim change
metrics.unavailable_when: gates not yet run
metrics.benchmark: 5 of 5 required before launch (internal rule)

metrics.name: tech_pack_status
metrics.plain: Whether a SKU has a current, versioned spec ready for sourcing
metrics.formula: flag from the tech pack table: current version has tolerances, BOM and packaging cost line filled
metrics.freshness_rule: stale after any supplier-side change without a new version
metrics.unavailable_when: no tech pack started
metrics.benchmark: not applicable, a readiness flag

metrics.name: candidate_pipeline_age_days
metrics.plain: How long a candidate has sat in the pipeline without a decision
metrics.formula: today minus the candidate's screen-in date
metrics.unavailable_when: candidate has already been decided (go or kill)
metrics.benchmark: no external benchmark; flagged against the brand's own time-box rule

metrics.name: shortlist_review_date_status
metrics.plain: Whether a shortlisted candidate's scheduled review has come due
metrics.formula: today compared against the review date set on the go/no-go memo
metrics.unavailable_when: no review date was set
metrics.benchmark: not applicable

metrics.name: sku_revenue_share
metrics.plain: Share of category revenue this SKU brings in
metrics.formula: SKU revenue ÷ total category revenue, trailing window
metrics.unavailable_when: SKU not yet live or no sales table linked
metrics.benchmark: no external benchmark; used to prioritise line-extension planning

metrics.name: sku_return_rate
metrics.plain: Share of units sold that come back
metrics.formula: returned units ÷ shipped units for the SKU, trailing window
metrics.unavailable_when: fewer than 20 units shipped
metrics.benchmark: no external benchmark; compared against the brand's own average return rate

insights.name: demand screen failed
insights.rule: candidate fails 2 or more of the demand, competition or store-fit checks in the screen
insights.sentence: {candidate} failed {n} of the fast checks. Killing it now saves the research hours.

insights.name: single-source video spike
insights.rule: video_commerce_demand_signal shows exactly 1 platform or creator source over the window
insights.sentence: {candidate}'s demand comes from one clip on one platform. Treat it as unverified until a second source confirms it.

insights.name: real sustained ad spend found
insights.rule: ad_library_spend_signal counts 3 or more advertisers with an ad live past 90 days
insights.sentence: {n} advertisers have kept an ad live for {days}+ days on this idea. That is a real spend signal, not a trend.

insights.name: trend up, category full
insights.rule: trend_direction_score is positive and competitive_saturation_count is above the brand's set ceiling
insights.sentence: {category} is growing, but {n} sellers already compete in it. Room left is smaller than the trend line suggests.

insights.name: margin gate failed
insights.rule: contribution_margin_pct_modelled is below the brand's set minimum threshold
insights.sentence: {candidate}'s modelled margin is {pct}%, below the {threshold}% floor. It cannot move to sourcing spend without a price, cost or channel change.

insights.name: actual margin trailing the model
insights.rule: contribution_margin_pct_actual is more than 5 points below contribution_margin_pct_modelled for the same SKU
insights.sentence: {sku} is making {actual}% margin against a {modelled}% model. Recheck landed cost and ad spend allocation.

insights.name: review price gap
insights.rule: review_price_signal is more than 15% below the candidate's planned price
insights.sentence: Reviewers say they would pay around {price}, {pct}% below the planned price. Recheck positioning before funding.

insights.name: unresolved category complaint
insights.rule: review_complaint_rate for the top complaint exceeds 15% of mined reviews
insights.sentence: {pct}% of reviews on the category leader mention the same complaint: {complaint}. That is the gap to build the angle on.

insights.name: seasonal candidate with no cash plan
insights.rule: demand_pattern_tag is seasonal or gifting and no cash timing note is attached
insights.sentence: {candidate} is tagged seasonal, but no cash plan is attached for its spike window. It cannot reach the shortlist without one.

insights.name: differentiation angle missing
insights.rule: differentiation_angle_confidence is unavailable (angle field empty) while the candidate is past the screening stage
insights.sentence: {candidate} has no stated point of difference. It should not reach a funding gate without one.

insights.name: candidate stalled past its time box
insights.rule: candidate_pipeline_age_days exceeds the time box set for its current stage
insights.sentence: {candidate} has sat at this stage for {days} days, past its {budget}-day box. Decide or kill it.

insights.name: shortlist review due
insights.rule: shortlist_review_date_status shows today at or past the set review date
insights.sentence: {candidate}'s review date has arrived. Bring it back to the founder for a fresh decision.
insights.severity: medium, keeps decisions from going stale

insights.name: hero SKU with no line extension
insights.rule: a SKU's sku_revenue_share is in the top decile of its category and no next-SKU candidate is open in the pipeline
insights.sentence: {sku} drives {pct}% of category revenue with no next SKU in the pipeline. Consider planning an extension.

insights.name: compliance gate incomplete
insights.rule: compliance_gate_status is unavailable while go_live_gate_pass_count shows other gates passed
insights.sentence: {candidate} has cleared {n} of 5 gates but the compliance check has not run. It is not fundable yet.

visuals.name: candidate funnel
visuals.shows: count of candidates at each stage: screened, researched, gated, shortlisted, go
visuals.why_this_chart: founder sees where candidates die and where the pipeline is thin

visuals.name: trend vs saturation map
visuals.shows: trend_direction_score on one axis, competitive_saturation_count on the other, one point per category
visuals.why_this_chart: the two signals together, not either alone, is the actual judgment call

visuals.name: SKU margin waterfall
visuals.shows: price stepping down through COGS, shipping, duty, ad spend and returns to net contribution margin
visuals.why_this_chart: shows exactly where a SKU's margin goes, modelled versus actual side by side

visuals.name: review complaint bars
visuals.shows: top recurring complaints from mined reviews, ranked by share of reviews mentioning them
visuals.why_this_chart: turns a pile of review text into a short, rankable gap list

visuals.name: ad spend timeline
visuals.shows: count of advertisers with a live ad on this product idea over the trailing 6 months
visuals.why_this_chart: shows whether spend is sustained or a single burst

visuals.name: shortlist scorecard grid
visuals.shows: each shortlisted candidate's score on every scorecard criterion, ranked
visuals.why_this_chart: the exact table the founder decides from, no separate memo to read

not_elsewhere.claim: combines video-commerce demand, ad library spend and DTC review mining in one screen before any paid research tool is used
not_elsewhere.vs: Helium 10 and Jungle Scout read Amazon Brand Analytics and keyword demand only; they do not touch TikTok-style shop data, ad libraries or a brand's own margin gate

not_elsewhere.claim: computes true contribution margin per SKU including allocated ad spend and returns, and checks it against the original gate model
not_elsewhere.vs: Shopify's native profit-by-SKU report is CM1 only: no ad spend allocation, no return cost, no way to compare against a pre-launch model

not_elsewhere.claim: enforces a visible, fixed research time box per candidate so research cannot sprawl
not_elsewhere.vs: no product research tool tracks hours spent against a budget; that discipline is normally left to the researcher

not_elsewhere.claim: ties a mined review price signal directly into the margin gate's pricing input
not_elsewhere.vs: review-mining browser extensions summarise sentiment as text; they do not feed a pricing or margin calculation

not_elsewhere.claim: reads trend direction and competitor count together as one go/no-go signal
not_elsewhere.vs: Google Trends and similar tools show a growth curve alone, with no seller-count overlay

founder_view_note: With nothing connected, the room shows an empty pipeline and every metric as unavailable, with a single prompt to add a first candidate. Once a candidate is screened, the room's first live view is the demand screen result and the funnel chart with one candidate in it; margin, trend and review metrics fill in as each check runs, and stay marked unavailable, never zero, until they do.

metrics.name: stock_cover_days
metrics.plain: How many days of stock are left at current sales pace
metrics.formula: current stock units ÷ trailing 14-day average daily units sold
metrics.source: inventory table joined to SKU sales
metrics.freshness_rule: stale after 48 hours without an inventory sync
metrics.unavailable_when: no inventory feed connected for that channel
metrics.benchmark: compared against the SKU's own lead_time_days plus safety buffer, not an external number

metrics.name: reorder_point_units
metrics.plain: The stock level that should trigger a new order
metrics.formula: (average daily units sold × lead_time_days) + safety_stock_units
metrics.window: recalculated weekly or on a velocity or lead-time change
metrics.unavailable_when: fewer than 30 days of sales history for the SKU
metrics.benchmark: no external benchmark; brand-specific by SKU

metrics.name: safety_stock_units
metrics.plain: Buffer stock held against demand spikes and delays
metrics.formula: service-level factor × demand standard deviation × sqrt(lead_time_days)
metrics.unavailable_when: fewer than 30 days of sales history
metrics.benchmark: no external benchmark; service level is a brand setting

metrics.name: landed_cost_per_unit
metrics.plain: What one unit actually costs after freight, duty and FX
metrics.formula: base supplier cost + freight allocated per unit + duty + FX conversion at the rate on the invoice date
metrics.window: recomputed on any FX, freight or duty change, else weekly
metrics.freshness_rule: stale after any linked FX or freight rate move of more than 3%
metrics.unavailable_when: no recent invoice or FX rate on file for the SKU
metrics.benchmark: compared against the price used in the SKU's margin gate, not an external number

metrics.name: supplier_concentration_share
metrics.plain: Share of purchase volume from the single largest supplier
metrics.formula: largest supplier's purchased units ÷ total purchased units, trailing 12 months
metrics.source: supplier master table joined to PO history
metrics.unavailable_when: fewer than 2 POs on file
metrics.benchmark: no external benchmark; flagged internally above 60%

metrics.name: country_concentration_share
metrics.plain: Share of purchase volume from the single largest sourcing country
metrics.formula: largest country's purchased units ÷ total purchased units, trailing 12 months
metrics.source: supplier master table joined to PO history
metrics.unavailable_when: fewer than 2 POs on file
metrics.benchmark: no external benchmark; flagged internally above 70%

metrics.name: supplier_scorecard_score
metrics.plain: A supplier's combined on-time, defect and price-stability score
metrics.formula: weighted score from on_time_delivery_pct, defect_rate_pct and price_change_frequency over the scoring period
metrics.freshness_rule: stale after 30 days without a new PO to score
metrics.unavailable_when: fewer than 2 completed POs with this supplier
metrics.benchmark: ranked against the brand's other suppliers, not an external index

metrics.name: fulfilment_sla_adherence_pct
metrics.plain: Share of orders the 3PL dispatched inside its promised time
metrics.formula: orders dispatched within contracted SLA window ÷ total orders processed
metrics.unavailable_when: no WMS or 3PL feed connected
metrics.benchmark: compared against the SLA written in the 3PL contract

metrics.name: courier_rto_rate
metrics.plain: Share of shipments a courier returns undelivered, by zone
metrics.formula: RTO shipments ÷ total shipments for that courier and zone
metrics.source: courier scorecard table (shipment and delivery status feed)
metrics.unavailable_when: fewer than 30 shipments for that courier-zone pair in the window
metrics.benchmark: compared across the brand's own couriers in the same zone, not an external figure

metrics.name: courier_first_attempt_delivery_rate
metrics.plain: Share of shipments delivered on the courier's first attempt
metrics.formula: shipments delivered on attempt 1 ÷ total delivered shipments, by courier and zone
metrics.unavailable_when: fewer than 30 shipments for that pair
metrics.benchmark: compared across the brand's own couriers, same zone

metrics.name: courier_delivery_tat_days
metrics.plain: Average days from dispatch to delivery, by courier and zone
metrics.formula: mean of (delivered_at − dispatched_at) in days, by courier and zone
metrics.unavailable_when: fewer than 30 shipments for that pair
metrics.benchmark: compared across the brand's own couriers, same zone

metrics.name: ndr_open_count
metrics.plain: How many non-delivery reports are open right now
metrics.formula: count of NDR records with status open, grouped by hours remaining in the attempt window
metrics.freshness_rule: stale after 6 hours without a courier status sync
metrics.unavailable_when: no courier NDR feed connected
metrics.benchmark: not applicable, an operational queue count

metrics.name: cod_remittance_variance
metrics.plain: Difference between what a courier should pay in COD and what it actually paid
metrics.formula: sum of expected COD amount per order − sum of amount actually remitted, by courier and period
metrics.source: COD remittance table joined to order records
metrics.freshness_rule: stale once a new remittance cycle closes without reconciliation
metrics.unavailable_when: remittance file not yet received from courier
metrics.benchmark: not applicable; any nonzero variance is a dispute candidate

metrics.name: dead_stock_value
metrics.plain: Value of stock that is old and barely moving
metrics.formula: units aged past the brand's dead-stock threshold × landed_cost_per_unit, summed by SKU
metrics.source: inventory age table joined to landed cost table
metrics.unavailable_when: no inventory age data for that SKU
metrics.benchmark: no external benchmark; threshold set per brand and category

metrics.name: price_lock_days_remaining
metrics.plain: Days left before a supplier's price lock or contract expires
metrics.formula: contract renewal_date − today, in days
metrics.unavailable_when: no contract on file for that supplier
metrics.benchmark: not applicable

metrics.name: three_way_match_exception_count
metrics.plain: How many purchase orders have a quantity or price mismatch against the invoice and goods received
metrics.formula: count of PO-invoice-GRN triplets where quantity or unit price differs beyond a set tolerance
metrics.freshness_rule: stale after 7 days without a new match run
metrics.unavailable_when: goods receipt not yet logged for that PO
metrics.benchmark: not applicable, an exception count

metrics.name: commodity_input_cost_index
metrics.plain: How the priced-in raw material behind a SKU is trending
metrics.formula: current commodity price ÷ price on the date the SKU's cost was last locked, indexed to 100
metrics.unavailable_when: no tracked commodity mapped to that SKU
metrics.benchmark: no external benchmark; used to time a cost-down ask

metrics.name: peak_season_readiness_pct
metrics.plain: How ready stock, staffing and systems are for the next festive peak
metrics.formula: average of (safety stock vs peak target, warehouse staffing booked vs target, WMS/OMS load-test pass) as percentages
metrics.window: checked weekly in the 90 days before the festival date
metrics.freshness_rule: stale after 14 days inside the 90-day window
metrics.unavailable_when: no peak season plan created for the upcoming festival
metrics.benchmark: 100% readiness target set per brand ahead of the date

metrics.name: ndr_to_rto_conversion_rate
metrics.plain: Share of NDRs that end up going back as RTO instead of delivering
metrics.formula: orders that end in RTO after an NDR ÷ total orders that had at least one NDR, trailing period
metrics.source: NDR queue table joined to shipment outcome
metrics.unavailable_when: fewer than 20 NDR cases in the window
metrics.benchmark: compared against the brand's own trailing average, not an external figure

insights.name: reorder breach
insights.rule: stock_cover_days is less than lead_time_days plus the safety buffer for that SKU
insights.sentence: {sku} has {days} days of cover against a {lead} day lead time. Place the order now.

insights.name: landed cost drifted without a margin recheck
insights.rule: landed_cost_per_unit has moved more than 5% since the last margin gate run for that SKU, and the gate has not been rerun
insights.sentence: {sku}'s landed cost moved {pct}% since its margin was last checked. Rerun the gate before the next order.

insights.name: supplier concentration risk
insights.rule: supplier_concentration_share exceeds 60% with no backup supplier mapped in a second country
insights.sentence: {pct}% of {sku}'s volume comes from one supplier with no mapped backup. One factory problem stops this SKU.

insights.name: supplier scorecard slipping
insights.rule: supplier_scorecard_score falls for 2 consecutive scoring periods
insights.sentence: {supplier}'s scorecard has dropped for {n} periods in a row. Review before the next PO.

insights.name: courier underperforming a zone
insights.rule: courier_rto_rate for a courier-zone pair is more than 10 points above the brand's best courier in the same zone
insights.sentence: {courier} runs a {pct} RTO rate in {zone}, {diff} points worse than {best_courier}. Shift volume.

insights.name: NDR aging toward its attempt window
insights.rule: an open NDR has fewer than 4 hours left before the courier's attempt window closes
insights.sentence: {n} NDRs close their attempt window in under 4 hours. Confirm the address or reschedule now.

insights.name: COD remittance shortfall
insights.rule: cod_remittance_variance is nonzero for a closed remittance cycle
insights.sentence: {courier} remitted {amount} less than expected for {period}. Open a billing dispute.

insights.name: stock turning into dead weight
insights.rule: a SKU's inventory age passes the brand's dead-stock threshold while its sales velocity stays below the brand's slow-mover line
insights.sentence: {sku} has {units} units aged past {days} days with barely any sales. Draft a clearance plan.

insights.name: price lock expiring soon
insights.rule: price_lock_days_remaining is under 30 days with no renegotiation started
insights.sentence: {supplier}'s price lock ends in {days} days. Start the renewal conversation now.

insights.name: invoice does not match goods received
insights.rule: three_way_match_exception_count is greater than 0 for a PO ready to pay
insights.sentence: {po_id} has a quantity or price mismatch against what was received. Hold payment and check it.

insights.name: commodity cost spike
insights.rule: commodity_input_cost_index rises more than 8% since the SKU's cost was last locked
insights.sentence: The raw material behind {sku} is up {pct}% since the last price lock. Recheck margin before the next PO.

insights.name: peak season not ready
insights.rule: peak_season_readiness_pct is below 80% with fewer than 45 days left to the festival date
insights.sentence: Peak-season readiness is {pct}% with {days} days to go. Stock, staffing or systems need attention now.

insights.name: NDR converting to RTO more than usual
insights.rule: ndr_to_rto_conversion_rate rises more than 10 points above the brand's trailing 90-day average
insights.sentence: NDRs are converting to RTO {pct} more than usual this period. Check address-confirmation outreach and courier performance.

metrics.name: listing_health_score
metrics.plain: Share of live listings passing the channel's own content rules
metrics.formula: listings with no open image, attribute or content error ÷ total live listings, per channel
metrics.freshness_rule: stale after 48 hours without a re-audit
metrics.unavailable_when: no catalogue feed connected for that channel
metrics.benchmark: no external benchmark; internally targeted at 100% per channel

metrics.name: image_video_spec_pass_rate
metrics.plain: Share of product images and videos meeting each channel's size and crop rules
metrics.formula: assets passing the channel's own spec check ÷ total assets checked, per channel
metrics.source: catalogue audit table, media spec checker
metrics.unavailable_when: no media spec checker run for that channel
metrics.benchmark: channel's own published spec, not a general standard

metrics.name: buy_box_win_rate
metrics.plain: Share of time this brand holds the Buy Box on its own listings
metrics.formula: time-weighted share of Buy Box ownership by the brand's own seller account ÷ total tracked time, per SKU
metrics.freshness_rule: stale after 24 hours without a snapshot
metrics.unavailable_when: no Buy Box tracking connected for that SKU
metrics.benchmark: no external benchmark; any loss on an actively advertised SKU is flagged

metrics.name: reseller_price_variance
metrics.plain: How far an unauthorised reseller's price sits below MAP
metrics.formula: (MAP price − lowest tracked reseller price) ÷ MAP price, per SKU
metrics.source: Buy Box and reseller price snapshot table
metrics.unavailable_when: no reseller price tracked for that SKU
metrics.benchmark: brand's own MAP policy, not an external figure

metrics.name: account_health_score
metrics.plain: How close the seller account is to a policy or performance suspension risk
metrics.formula: channel's own account health metrics (order defect rate, policy strikes, late shipment rate) rolled into a single risk flag against the channel's stated suspension thresholds
metrics.window: trailing 30 to 90 days per channel's own window
metrics.unavailable_when: no account health feed connected for that channel
metrics.benchmark: the channel's own published suspension threshold

metrics.name: review_rating_avg
metrics.plain: Average star rating per SKU per channel
metrics.formula: mean of star ratings on live reviews, per SKU per channel
metrics.unavailable_when: fewer than 5 reviews on that SKU-channel pair
metrics.benchmark: no external benchmark; compared against the brand's own other SKUs on the same channel

metrics.name: catalogue_feed_freshness_hours
metrics.plain: How long since the shared catalogue feed last synced
metrics.formula: now − last successful feed sync timestamp
metrics.freshness_rule: stale after 24 hours without a sync
metrics.unavailable_when: no feed pipeline configured
metrics.benchmark: not applicable, an operational freshness check

metrics.name: quick_commerce_reported_roas
metrics.plain: The ROAS the platform's own dashboard shows
metrics.formula: platform-reported ad revenue ÷ platform-reported ad spend, as the platform calculates it (often on MRP)
metrics.unavailable_when: no ad dashboard export for that platform
metrics.benchmark: platform's own stated benchmark range, shown alongside the corrected figure

metrics.name: quick_commerce_true_roas
metrics.plain: ROAS recalculated from actual transaction value, not MRP
metrics.formula: sum of actual transaction value on attributed orders ÷ ad spend, using the real selling price after platform discount
metrics.source: quick commerce orders table joined to ad spend export
metrics.unavailable_when: transaction-level order value not available from the platform export
metrics.benchmark: compared directly against quick_commerce_reported_roas for the same period

metrics.name: settlement_variance_amount
metrics.plain: Difference between what a marketplace should pay out and what it actually paid
metrics.formula: sum of expected settlement value from order records − actual amount received, per platform per period
metrics.source: settlement reports joined to order records
metrics.freshness_rule: stale once a new cycle closes without reconciliation
metrics.unavailable_when: settlement report not yet received from the platform
metrics.benchmark: not applicable; any nonzero variance is a dispute candidate

metrics.name: dark_store_fill_rate_pct
metrics.plain: Share of dark stores carrying this SKU in stock right now
metrics.formula: dark stores with stock greater than zero for the SKU ÷ total dark stores expected to carry it
metrics.freshness_rule: stale after 24 hours without a feed sync
metrics.unavailable_when: no dark store inventory feed connected for that platform
metrics.benchmark: no external benchmark; internally targeted near 100% for hero SKUs

metrics.name: ad_credit_utilization_pct
metrics.plain: Share of a platform's ad credit used before it expires
metrics.formula: ad credit spent ÷ ad credit granted, for the current credit cycle
metrics.unavailable_when: no ad credit ledger available for that platform
metrics.benchmark: not applicable, tracked against the cycle's own expiry date

metrics.name: amazon_ipi_score
metrics.plain: Amazon's Inventory Performance Index score
metrics.formula: value as reported by Amazon Seller Central
metrics.unavailable_when: no Amazon inventory export connected
metrics.benchmark: Amazon's own published storage-limit thresholds by score band

metrics.name: amazon_replenishment_alert_count
metrics.plain: How many FBA SKUs are below their recommended replenishment level
metrics.formula: count of SKUs where FBA sellable stock is below the recommended reorder trigger from cover targets
metrics.source: Amazon inventory table joined to reorder calc
metrics.unavailable_when: no Amazon inventory feed connected
metrics.benchmark: not applicable, an operational alert count

metrics.name: sales_change_attribution
metrics.plain: Whether an Amazon sales change is a traffic problem or a conversion problem
metrics.formula: split of the sales change into the portion explained by session/impression change versus the portion explained by conversion rate change, holding the other constant
metrics.unavailable_when: fewer than 100 sessions in either window
metrics.benchmark: not applicable, a diagnostic split

metrics.name: listing_staleness_days
metrics.plain: Days since a Flipkart, Myntra or Nykaa listing was last updated
metrics.formula: today − last_updated_at, per listing
metrics.unavailable_when: listing not yet tracked in the audit table
metrics.benchmark: no external benchmark; flagged internally past 90 days

metrics.name: bis_compliance_status
metrics.plain: Whether a regulated SKU's BIS, hallmarking or labelling documentation is on file and current
metrics.formula: flag from the compliance docs table: required doc types present and not expired
metrics.unavailable_when: no compliance doc type mapped for that SKU's category
metrics.benchmark: not applicable, a legal gate

insights.name: listing failing channel spec
insights.rule: listing_health_score for a channel drops below 95%, or any single listing has an open image or attribute error
insights.sentence: {n} listings on {channel} fail a content or image rule right now. Fix before the next sync.
insights.severity: medium, blocks visibility or ads eligibility

insights.name: Buy Box lost on an advertised SKU
insights.rule: buy_box_win_rate falls below 80% for a SKU that is currently running ads
insights.sentence: {sku} is only winning the Buy Box {pct}% of the time while ads are live. Ad spend is funding someone else's sale.

insights.name: MAP violation detected
insights.rule: reseller_price_variance shows a tracked reseller price more than 10% below MAP
insights.sentence: A reseller is selling {sku} {pct}% below MAP. Flag it before it drags down price perception everywhere.

insights.name: account health approaching suspension risk
insights.rule: account_health_score crosses the channel's own stated warning threshold
insights.sentence: {channel} account health has crossed its warning line. Address it before it becomes a suspension.

insights.name: true ROAS far below what the dashboard shows
insights.rule: quick_commerce_reported_roas exceeds quick_commerce_true_roas by more than 20%
insights.sentence: {platform} shows {reported}x ROAS, but the real number on transaction value is {true}x. Do not scale spend on the reported figure.

insights.name: settlement shortfall
insights.rule: settlement_variance_amount is nonzero and beyond a small rounding tolerance for a closed cycle
insights.sentence: {platform} paid {amount} less than the order records show for {period}. Send to Finance to dispute.

insights.name: dark store stockout risk
insights.rule: dark_store_fill_rate_pct for a hero SKU falls below 70% for 2 consecutive days
insights.sentence: {sku} is out of stock in {pct}% of its dark stores for {n} days running. Expect a ranking penalty.

insights.name: ad credit going unused
insights.rule: ad_credit_utilization_pct is below 50% with fewer than 10 days left in the credit cycle
insights.sentence: {platform} ad credit is {pct}% used with {days} days left in the cycle. Spend it or lose it.

insights.name: IPI score risking storage limits
insights.rule: amazon_ipi_score falls below Amazon's published storage-limit threshold
insights.sentence: Amazon IPI score is {score}, below the storage-limit line. Storage capacity may be restricted.

insights.name: sales drop is a conversion problem, not traffic
insights.rule: sales_change_attribution shows over 70% of a sales drop explained by conversion rate, with traffic flat or up
insights.sentence: Sales fell {pct}%, but traffic held steady. The problem is on the listing or price, not visibility.

insights.name: stale marketplace listing
insights.rule: listing_staleness_days exceeds 90 for a listing on Flipkart, Myntra or Nykaa
insights.sentence: {sku} on {channel} has not been updated in {days} days. Review it against current competitor listings.

insights.name: compliance document missing before go-live
insights.rule: bis_compliance_status is unavailable or expired for a SKU category that requires it, and the listing is live or scheduled
insights.sentence: {sku} needs a current BIS or hallmarking document before it can stay live. It is missing or expired.

insights.name: catalogue feed gone stale
insights.rule: catalogue_feed_freshness_hours exceeds 24 while ads or listings depend on it
insights.sentence: The shared catalogue feed has not synced in {hours} hours. Ads and listings may be running on old data.
